rationale: The Latin anchors *pittacium* (a patch/piece of cloth), *commissura* (a joint/seam), and *lamina* (a thin plate/sheet) all point to a concrete, physical fragment or patch — a separate part of a whole material object. This aligns best with piece.n.01 ("a separate part of a whole"), as OE CLÚT refers to a piece, patch, or plate of material (cloth, metal, etc.), not a serving, artwork, or abstract instance.
